paragraphs: RFP360.AI sells software for the RFP and proposal lifecycle, built for the organization issuing a request and for the company responding to it. Buyer tools cover creating RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs from dynamic templates, gathering supplier responses in one dashboard, and running approval workflows across procurement, legal, and technical teams. Supplier tools generate first-draft responses from a centralized knowledge base and rank opportunities with Go/No-Go decision matrices.

A pricing plan on the same page is offered to procurement teams, government agencies, or enterprises managing multiple sourcing events. A separate solutions page covers public procurement and says sourcing must adhere to federal, state, and local regulations, including CJIS, FISMA, and FAR.

One named customer on the site is Tri-Force Consulting Services, described as a company responding to many government and enterprise RFPs. Pricing runs from a pay-per-RFP option for individual suppliers, consultants, or small teams who respond occasionally to a custom enterprise plan.

quote.text: Whether you manage procurement for a government agency or run a proposal team at a growing saas company, RFP360.AI simplifies every stage of your workflow.
